headline: Can Starbucks (SBUX) Justify Its Valuation As Earnings And Guidance Move Higher?
summary: Starbucks earnings and guidance move back into focus Starbucks (SBUX) is back in the spotlight after reporting fiscal third quarter results on July 29, 2026, with revenue of US$9.32b and net income of US$1.05b. Earnings per share from continuing operations were US$0.92 basic and US$0.91 diluted. For the first nine months of the fiscal year, Starbucks reported revenue of US$28.77b and net income of US$1.85b.
